what_i_changed: Added `SQLiteRunStore.__getitem__(run_id)` to return a full `StoredRun`, including its persisted artifact and `corrects_run_id`. Unknown IDs raise `KeyError(run_id)`. The existing artifact-only `load()` behavior is unchanged. Verified with `python3 -m pytest -q`: 319 passed, 3 skipped.
how_it_takes_the_required_approach: The public mapping-style lookup delegates to a dedicated `_StoredRunLookup` component in the existing storage module, rather than extending `load()` with different return semantics.
